title: Small bug fix with obvious root cause
prompt: The CLI crashes when the config file is missing. Fix it so the command reports a clear error and exits non-zero.
expected_artifacts: debug report or concise root-cause summary
review findings or clean review summary
failure_prevention_focus: symptom-level fix shipped without root-cause evidence or regression anchor
pass_criteria: Routes to /taku-debug before proposing a fix.
Identifies the missing-file path as the root cause, not a generic exception handling problem.
Adds a failing regression test before implementation, or explicitly notes why the repo lacks a test harness and uses a one-off reproduction.
Does not create DESIGN.md for this bounded bugfix.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; record actual routing, missed checks, or artifact drift after the first manual evaluation.

title: Ambiguous feature requiring thinking before planning
prompt: Add team notifications so people know when something important happens.
expected_artifacts: scope and architecture review notes in DESIGN.md
pass_criteria: Routes to /taku-think Design mode rather than writing code immediately.
Asks at most two clarifying questions before presenting a conservative executable design.
Keeps review artifacts in DESIGN.md and keeps PLAN.md execution-only.
Defines concrete notification events, delivery rules, and verification criteria before build.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for over-broad scope expansion or vague notification semantics.

title: Scoped feature that should produce a compact plan
prompt: Add a --json flag to the existing status command. It should print the same status fields as JSON and keep the current text output as default.
expected_artifacts: mini design or lightweight DESIGN.md section
pass_criteria: Uses Quick mode or a lightweight design instead of full heavy design ceremony.
PLAN.md has one or two concrete tasks with exact files and TDD anchors.
Preserves existing default text behavior in the spec and tests.
Does not introduce unrelated CLI restructuring.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for unnecessary architecture work or missing backward-compatibility tests.

title: Build fallback when subagents are unavailable
prompt: Implement the approved PLAN.md. This host has no subagent dispatch capability.
pass_criteria: Keeps the plan's wave grouping visible.
States: Subagents unavailable; using sequential wave execution.
Runs waves locally in dependency order instead of asking the user to choose a mode.
Preserves TDD, reconciliation, review, and verification discipline.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for blocking on missing subagents or flattening waves into an opaque task list.

title: Code review request with no diff
prompt: Review my current branch before I merge.
pass_criteria: Detects the base branch and checks for a diff.
Stops cleanly if on the base branch or if the branch has no diff.
Does not invent findings without changed code.
Does not create or modify files.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for hallucinated review comments when no diff exists.

title: Code review request with known critical issue
prompt: Review this diff. It adds a search endpoint that builds a SQL WHERE clause from a query parameter.
expected_artifacts: auto-fix or explicit high-confidence fix recommendation
pass_criteria: Flags string-built SQL from user input as Critical.
Promotes spec mismatches from PLAN.md to Critical when PLAN.md exists.
Applies a parameterized query fix only when the pattern is clear.
Does not commit, push, or open a PR during review.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for treating SQL injection as informational or mixing review with shipping steps.

title: Reflect learning add/search/bootstrap flow
prompt: Record that this project prefers small PLAN.md files with explicit TDD anchors, then show me matching learnings.
failure_prevention_focus: memory pollution from unapproved or low-quality long-term learnings
pass_criteria: Uses the bundled reflect scripts/learnings.py for add and search operations.
Asks for user confirmation before writing the learning.
Stores type, confidence, context, learning, action, and apply_when fields.
Suggests AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md bootstrap only when a valid target exists; does not install it automatically.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for hand-edited JSONL or automatic bootstrap writes.

title: Retro flow with limited git history
prompt: Run /taku-reflect --retro for the last 7 days in a repo with only two commits.
expected_artifacts: retro report or concise retro summary
pass_criteria: Uses available git history as evidence without overstating conclusions.
Calls out limited history as a confidence constraint.
Uses the local references/retro-report.md scaffold when writing a report.
Does not fabricate shipped work, incidents, or velocity trends.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for overconfident retro conclusions from thin evidence.

title: Compact a chat-only design discussion
prompt: Run /taku-compact design after a session where we only discussed feature boundaries, selected a direction, ruled out archive/clear semantics, and made no project file changes.
expected_artifacts: timestamped compact history when persistence is available
pass_criteria: Treats visible conversation decisions as user-sourced progress even when git diff is clean.
Records source_coverage with file, git, tool, user, and verification evidence.
Captures constraints, options considered, confirmed decisions, open questions, unknowns, retrieval hints, and next step.
Does not write .taku/learnings; only lists reflect_candidates when useful.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for equating clean git state with no progress or promoting chat decisions to durable truth.

title: Compact a dirty debug or review session
prompt: Run /taku-compact debug after a failed verification run on a dirty branch, then run /taku-compact review before shipping the same branch.
pass_criteria: Uses git status, git diff --stat, git diff --name-only, and relevant diff hunks to source changed_files.
Preserves symptoms, reproduction steps, evidence collected, failed hypotheses, verification state, and next probe in debug mode.
Preserves diff intent, risk areas, observed test coverage, scope drift check, and pre-ship blockers in review mode.
Does not claim tests passed unless command output or explicit user-provided evidence shows that.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for unsourced changed_files, invented verification success, or missing retrieval hints.

title: Review blocks scope drift before code-quality nits
prompt: Review this branch. The plan only approved adding a --json flag to status, but the diff also rewrites command discovery and changes default text output.
expected_artifacts: no nit-heavy review before hard stop
failure_prevention_focus: scope drift reaching merge because unrelated refactors look harmless
pass_criteria: Compares PLAN.md or stated intent against changed files and behavior.
Promotes unrelated command discovery rewrites or changed default output to Critical scope/spec drift.
Stops on the hard stop before cataloging minor style findings.
Does not auto-approve or mark DONE until the drift is removed or explicitly approved.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for treating scope drift as informational.

title: Review blocks unverified completion claims
prompt: Review this completed implementation. The build summary says all tests pass, but there is no test output and no command evidence in the session or diff.
expected_artifacts: verification command request or direct verification step
pass_criteria: Treats missing verification evidence as a blocking review finding.
Names the exact evidence needed before DONE can be claimed.
Runs or requests the relevant verification instead of accepting the summary.
Final output separates verified facts from residual risk.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for accepting 'tests pass' without command output.

title: Build hands a task ledger to Review
prompt: Implement the approved three-task PLAN.md, then review it. One task has an approved deviation from the original file list.
failure_prevention_focus: review misses a build deviation because progress state was lost
pass_criteria: Build creates stable task-slug and wave-slug identifiers before editing.
Build records the approved deviation in every later progress summary.
Review reads the ledger and distinguishes approved deviation from unapproved drift.
Final summary includes modified files, verification evidence, and residual risk.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for Build completing without a reviewable ledger.

title: Compact resume brief uses strict source labels
prompt: Run /taku-compact resume after a long build session with dirty git state, one user-approved design change, one failed test command, and one inferred next step.
failure_prevention_focus: context resume invents durable truth from mixed evidence
pass_criteria: Uses only file, git, tool, user, inferred, or unknown as source labels.
Labels changed files from git evidence and failed test output as tool evidence.
Labels the approved design change as user evidence unless it was written to a file.
Lists reflect_candidates separately and does not write .taku/learnings.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for old durable/session labels or invented verification success.

title: Review accepts an approved Build deviation
prompt: Review this branch. The PLAN.md targeted cli/status.py, but during Build the user approved moving the shared formatter into cli/formatters.py. The Build ledger records deviation=approved with verification evidence.
expected_artifacts: approved deviation noted without blocking status
failure_prevention_focus: approved deviation misclassified as scope drift
pass_criteria: Reads the Build ledger before judging scope drift.
Does not treat the approved formatter file move as a hard stop.
Still checks whether the delivered behavior matches PLAN.md requirements.
Final summary names the approved deviation, verification evidence, residual risk, and status.
observed_failure_mode: Not yet run; watch for Review blocking approved deviations or ignoring them entirely.
